justifications.durability: A real, tested gain with a mutation-killed guard: the selector can no longer silently switch itself off when the store moves, which was the exact hazard the prior review flagged, and the added tests pin both the order-independence and the refusal. Marks off only for the residual coupling to the current store layout (file-presence probing) and for the unversioned map the behaviour depends on.
justifications.evidence: Strong and independent: I reproduced the defect at base (both mutations return [] and admit every proven loop), reproduced the fix at head (resolves 27-52; raises on the empty-of-magnetics catalogue), and killed both new tests by mutation -- replacing the ValueError with a permissive return makes test_differential_targets_refuse_a_declared_store_with_no_magnetics_file fail (1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1), and restricting the resolver to catalog.maps[:1] makes test_differential_targets_resolve_when_the_first_map_is_not_magnetics fail (1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1). Gate reproduced both arms (base 88 passed, head 90 passed, EXIT=0 each) and whole-tree ruff is clean. Marks off for the run's own record: the gate log's revision header names the base, and no baseline/after arms are supplied, so the run's own record cannot support its count without re-measurement.
justifications.fit: Follows the module's idiom: a small private helper with a full docstring, ValueError for the refusal as the module's other selectors use, reuses replace/load_packaged_machine_map, and the tests use the file's existing pytest helpers. Marks off for a docstring wording that overstates the mechanism and for a helper/test naming that is verbose relative to the module's terser neighbours.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The repair does precisely what the rejected commit's review asked: the store resolution is independent of map order, and an unresolvable declared store fails closed. Both behaviours are pinned by tests and reproduced independently. One mark off because the fragment (part of the deliverable) mislabels the tested revision, and the docstring describes the mechanism as a 'declared magnetics IDS' lookup where the code probes for magnetics.nc by file presence.
justifications.reuse: Good: no new catalogue reader, the helper reuses description_store_root_path's resolution and the existing load_packaged_machine_map, the test helper _catalogue_with_maps centralises the monkeypatch rather than repeating it, and no constant is duplicated. It also removes the maps[0] inference the prior review faulted.
justifications.scope_discipline: Exemplary: writes stayed on the three declared paths, the fenced maps/ tree was not touched (the run explicitly declined to write there and carried the maps finding as a follow-on), no plan/index/sprint mutation, no stray files, worktree clean at head.

The node repairs the fail-open differential-flux-loop selector the rejected commit's review flagged: _magnetics_description_store locates the description store by trying every declared map for magnetics.nc rather than inferring it from catalog.maps[0].name, and a declared store whose maps carry no magnetics.nc now raises ValueError instead of resolving to the empty set that admits every proven loop. Two tests pin it.

REPRODUCTION (mine, scratch trees under $TMPDIR extracted by git archive at each revision, imas_alambic from the shared editable install, imas_ambix from the scratch tree via PYTHONPATH).
- DEFECT AT BASE: with the live jt-60sa catalogue (maps ['OP1','OP2'], description_store_root 'description') mutated so the first declared map's directory is not magnetics, base _differential_flux_loop_targets('jt-60sa') returns [] (fail open); mutating every map to a non-magnetics name also returns [] (fail open). Both would admit all 17 proven loops as absolute.
- FALSIFICATION OF THE FIX AT HEAD: the same first-map mutation returns [27..52] (resolved); the every-map-renamed mutation raises ValueError('... no declared map carries magnetics.nc ...'); exiting non-zero is not needed since the raise is the asserted behaviour.
- TEST FALSIFICATION: replacing the ValueError with a permissive return in the scratch head tree makes test_differential_targets_refuse_a_declared_store_with_no_magnetics_file fail (DID NOT RAISE; 1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1). Restricting the resolver to catalog.maps[:1] makes test_differential_targets_resolve_when_the_first_map_is_not_magnetics fail (ValueError raised; 1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1). Both new guards fire.
- GATE: five-file gate (test_jt60sa_signal_maps, test_jt60sa_unit_audit, test_jt60sa_machine_map, test_operator_differential_loops, test_cocos_convention): base 0c62c8cf 88 passed EXIT=0; head 6394dcb0 90 passed EXIT=0. - ANNEX: the run's sign-cohort.log exits 0 with surviving COCOS candidates (1, 2, 11, 12) and one flux channel per shot, loop 7 alone as reference; not re-run here (corpus read, not the node's changed paths).
